subject: Specifications, wiring and ordering information of the AQ-210 CO₂, temperature and humidity sensor
keywords: CO2 sensor, NDIR, Modbus RTU, BACnet MS/TP, data sheet
tagline: CO₂, temperature and relative humidity in one wall-mounted unit, with Modbus RTU and BACnet MS/TP on the same terminals.

features.text: Dual-beam NDIR CO₂ sensor, no recalibration for 15 years
Modbus RTU and BACnet MS/TP, chosen by DIP switch
Two 0–10 V outputs and one relay

overview: The AQ-210 measures carbon dioxide, temperature and relative humidity in offices, classrooms and meeting rooms, and sends them to the building management system so that ventilation follows the people in the room rather than a timetable.

Its dual-beam NDIR cell compares the measuring beam with a reference beam on every reading, so it does not drift with age and needs no automatic baseline correction. This makes it suitable for rooms that are never empty, such as hospital wards and control rooms.

The coloured ring on the front tells the people in the room how fresh the air is: green below 800 ppm, amber up to 1,200 ppm and red above. The thresholds can be changed over the bus, and the ring can be turned off.

specification_notes: The accuracy figures apply after 15 minutes of warm-up. Accuracy of CO₂ includes the repeatability and the effect of pressure between 950 and 1,050 hPa.

small_print: Each unit is supplied with its mounting plate, two screws and an installation sheet. Configuration software and the BACnet PICS can be downloaded from [kestrel-sensing.example/aq210](https://kestrel-sensing.example/aq210).
